critique: The five asymmetric bone, olive, and umber slabs trading size and position along a load-weighted tension wire make a spare, high-contrast terracotta composition whose motion is conceptually legible. Yet the hanging-mobile grammar remains familiar rather than truly anti-pattern, while the 16-pixel guinea-pig image reads as an arbitrary hidden joke; a stranger rule for how slabs split, collide, or transfer mass would deliver the requested unfamiliarity.
